a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take) only works about 4% of the time for each of us. Both units start empty, so a storm after round 1 kills us both. Only one of us can get 4 cells right now, so I'm taking 4 this round rather than doing it behind your back. After that I'll choose operate every round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more. If you also take this round, the split is random and we'll likely both end up short, so please operate instead.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you directly. From now on I'll choose operate every round and take nothing more, so the reserve can build back up to 4 for you. Please choose operate too, since the generator only runs if we both do.
